formal_statement: ∀ p : Polynomial ℕ, ∃ l : ℕ, ∀ π : List (PEqualNP.Search.QLine (Fin (2 ^ l + 1) × Fin l)), PEqualNP.Search.IsResLinQRefutation (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.BPHP (2 ^ l + 1) l) π → (∀ L ∈ π, L.length ≤ 4 * l ∧ ∀ e ∈ L, ∀ v, (e.1 v).natAbs ≤ 2 ^ l) → p.eval (2 ^ l) < π.length
plain_statement: Every Res(lin) refutation over the integers of bit PHP (2^l+1 pigeons, n = 2^l holes) whose lines have at most 4l equations and whose coefficients have absolute value at most n has superpolynomially many lines. Follows from L-lib-089 and the Beame-Whitmeyer rectangle-dag bound; no source we found states it. The restricted form of L-alg-004.
title: Restricted R(lin) lower bound: bit PHP needs superpolynomial refutations with lines of O(log n) equations and coefficients up to n
